levels.surface: أبو نصر أحمد بن الحسين الضبي

notes: «قال سمعت أبا بكر الحمامي الفراء» makes Abu Bakr a link (rule 5). His own account («أودعني بعض الناس وديعة») is the saying, so he is the last link. The depositor, the owner of the deposit and the man in the dream are in the scene only.
The leading «3-» is the report number, not part of a surface.
